title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
problem: Refactoring large real-world programs into synthesizable and efficient hardware is brittle and computationally expensive.
assumption_broken: Refactoring knowledge need not remain a fixed manual or static retrieval corpus.
operational_signature: Attempt → diagnose → retrieve → rewrite → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrieve successful plans and generalized failure critiques from accumulated synthesis and simulation experience to guide new refactoring tasks.

improver_modified.how: Accumulated factual critiques and strategic plans augment the identifiers and planner on subsequent tasks.

limitations_evident: Dissimilar retrieved tasks can introduce noise
Large-program distribution shifts reduce memory transfer
Retry averages exclude failed runs

title: ISM:Self-Improving Strategy Memory for Continual Mathematical Reasoning
problem: Frozen mathematical solvers lose reusable strategies between episodes while passive memories grow and accumulate noise.
assumption_broken: External strategy memory need not only accumulate entries but can actively revise its content and retrieval hooks.
operational_signature: Retrieve → solve → verify → audit → revise → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Symbolically gated lifecycle maintenance refines both strategy schemas and their retrieval features using successes and failures.

improver_modified.how: Outcome-dependent updates change the strategy content and retrieval hooks supplied to subsequent solver episodes.

limitations_evident: Single seed and stream ordering
No individual-mechanism ablations
Single solver backbone and short-answer verification

title: A Self-Evolving Agentic System for Automated Generation and Execution of Biological Protocols
problem: Biological intent and quantitative constraints become misaligned when protocols are translated into executable laboratory code.
assumption_broken: Protocol-to-code translation need not use a fixed skill set or end before physical experimental feedback.
operational_signature: Decompose → specify → translate → validate → execute → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: A runtime-revised library of parameter, layout and device-operation skills preserves constraints across protocol-to-code conversion.

improver_modified.how: Creation-evaluation-revision loops update the reusable operational skills used by the coding agent.

limitations_evident: Physical validation covers selected biological workflows
Expert rules and device-specific checks remain necessary
Skill-update contribution is not isolated in the supplied text

title: Libra: Training the Environment for Agentic Information Retrieval
problem: Static repository indices fail to adapt to the navigation errors made by coding agents.
assumption_broken: The repository environment itself can be trained while solver weights, prompts and tools remain frozen.
operational_signature: Sample → query → navigate → diagnose → rewrite → replay
load_bearing_mechanism: A healer rewrites hierarchical plain-text catalogs using synthetic-query localization failures and gold paths.
limitations_evident: Computationally intensive catalog training
Only fixed repository snapshots evaluated
Synthetic queries are primarily single-hop

title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
problem: Robot coding agents cannot reliably localize physical execution failures or reuse the repairs learned on earlier tasks.
assumption_broken: Robot programs and their reusable repair library can improve through execution rather than relying on fixed skills and coarse rollout feedback.
operational_signature: Execute → inspect → diagnose → mutate → validate → distill
load_bearing_mechanism: Fine-grained multimodal primitive traces ground validated repairs that are distilled into a shared transferable skill library.

improver_modified.how: New validated repair skills guide later actor debugging and candidate generation.

limitations_evident: Real-world success detection and safe resets remain external requirements
Expressiveness is bounded by predefined robot APIs
Compute-intensive search and incomplete library maintenance

title: M2Note: Continual Evolution of Vision Language Models via Mistake Notebook Learning
problem: Vision-language models repeat structured reasoning errors while weight updates are expensive and brittle.
assumption_broken: Continual multimodal adaptation can edit external guidance rather than model parameters.
operational_signature: Retrieve → answer → reflect → merge → re-evaluate → commit
load_bearing_mechanism: Rollback-gated batch verification retains only mistake-notebook updates that improve accuracy on the current batch.

improver_modified.how: The shared evolving notebook is retrieved in subsequent solving and error-refinement iterations.

limitations_evident: Online evaluation updates memory on test batches
Long-tail visual diversity weakens retrieval
Cross-model guidance can hurt mismatched solvers

title: Self-Evolving Agents with Anytime-Valid Certificates
problem: Self-modifying agents invalidate guarantees when their own policies generate data, evaluators and search spaces.
assumption_broken: Agent improvements need not be unconstrained self-edits and can instead be gated within a small versioned policy substrate.
operational_signature: Propose → reproduce → search → measure → gate → certify
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-authored reproduction tests supply in-loop feedback while statistical gates constrain steering and harness changes against an error budget.

improver_modified.how: Online directive shaping and verified repair alter the steering policy and agent harness.

limitations_evident: Composed endogenous-loop guarantees remain conjectures
Single run per configuration on 52 tasks
Base-model capability limits gains and self-oracles can misjudge patches

title: COMFYCLAW: Self-Evolving Skill Harnesses for Image Generation Workflows
problem: Image workflow agents repeatedly rediscover repairs and can break executable graphs during visual refinement.
assumption_broken: Workflow control skills can be actively revised from execution and visual feedback rather than remaining static.
operational_signature: Construct → render → verify → repair → cluster → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Clustered workflow traces produce skill mutations retained only after non-degradation on synthesized validation prompts.

improver_modified.how: Evolved workflow-editing skills change the reusable procedures available during later construction and repair.

limitations_evident: Only image workflows evaluated
Validation prompts are synthesized from discovery clusters
Reliance on VLM-based visual judgments

title: SkillCoach: Self-Evolving Rubrics for Evaluating and Enhancing Agentic Skill-Use
problem: Final task success hides incorrect skill selection, skipped procedures and accidental verifier passing.
assumption_broken: The process evaluator can itself evolve from trajectories instead of treating outcome success as sufficient supervision.
operational_signature: Roll out → score → arbitrate → patch → validate → filter
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-grounded local rubric patches pass held-out validation gates before the rubric filters supervised training trajectories.

improver_modified.how: The versioned process evaluator is revised and subsequently supplies trajectory-selection supervision.

limitations_evident: Selected task pool is smaller than production skill repositories
Only offline supervised training reported
Rubric audit remains judge-assisted

title: From Failing to Passing: Evolving Natural Language Prompt Optimization Rules for LLM Code Generation
problem: Execution-feedback code repair cannot resolve failures caused by how the original specification is phrased.
assumption_broken: Reusable surface-level rewriting rules can improve coding without task-specific system prompts or weight updates.
operational_signature: Rewrite → generate → execute → categorize → mutate → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Pareto search evolves semantics-preserving prompt transformation rules as a complementary fallback to execution-feedback repair.

improver_modified.how: Evolved transformation rules alter the rewriter used to repair future problem statements.

limitations_evident: Empty-seed rules did not generalize to the test set
APPS evaluation caps tests at ten per problem
Search depends on external rewriter and mutator models

title: EvoAgentBench: Benchmarking Agent Self-Evolution via Ability Transfer
problem: Existing evaluations conflate information retention, procedural transfer and unsupported task splits.
assumption_broken: Held-out tasks can be instance-disjoint while guaranteeing relevant procedural support in training experience.
operational_signature: Collect → extract → canonicalize → link → split → transfer-test
load_bearing_mechanism: Ability graphs enforce train-side procedural support and expose encoding, routing and uptake failures under matched evaluation conditions.
limitations_evident: Anchor uses curator-side test routing labels
Ability extraction depends on one LLM
Pretraining contamination and headroom-selected split limit absolute-score interpretation

title: MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution
problem: Skill evolution stalls when the fixed improvement procedure cannot revise its own diagnosis and proposal habits.
assumption_broken: The improvement policy can be an editable skill object rather than immutable orchestration.
operational_signature: Diagnose → retrieve → allocate → propose → evaluate → recursively revise
load_bearing_mechanism: A slower loop applies the same five-agent pipeline to branch-local meta-skills using descendant productivity feedback.

improver_modified.how: The diagnosis, retrieval, allocation, proposal and edit-execution skill files evolve on the slow timescale.

limitations_evident: Three curated benchmarks and one backbone
Pipeline roles and wiring remain fixed
Fixed meta-update horizon and unclear full compute matching

title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
problem: Fixed agent harnesses cannot adapt to task-specific execution failures encountered during unlabeled evaluation.
assumption_broken: Evaluation can update executable control logic without access to final-answer labels or model gradients.
operational_signature: Execute → inspect → branch → edit → judge → carry forward
load_bearing_mechanism: Diverse trace-guided harness edits are selected with execution-derived partial checks and persisted across batches.
limitations_evident: Transductive evaluation selects on the scored unlabeled batch
Proxy success does not establish semantic correctness
Judge can reject genuinely better candidate harnesses

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
problem: Harness-evolution gains are confounded by extra search compute and reuse of benchmark verification feedback.
assumption_broken: Higher benchmark scores after evolution do not necessarily imply reusable harness improvements.
operational_signature: Match budgets → refine trajectories → edit harnesses → separate tasks → compare
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled feedback and inference budgets plus held-out evaluation distinguish task-level search from transferable harness design.
limitations_evident: Positive game results optimize individual evaluation tasks
Terminal-Bench harness gains generalize poorly
Two independent runs are reported without explicit variance in the supplied text

title: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: Skill evolution assumes a reliable grader even when deployed tasks lack an executable evaluation metric.
assumption_broken: The grading function can evolve, but its validity must be tested independently from downstream task scores.
operational_signature: Cluster → synthesize detectors → anchor → compose → select → alternate
load_bearing_mechanism: Sparse anchored labels gate detector compositions while reliability-weighted unlabeled consensus regularizes evaluator search.

improver_modified.how: The evolved metric grades the alternating skill-learning loop and changes which failures drive skill synthesis.

limitations_evident: Skill rollback reads the nominal locked test set
One model family and small locked sets
Semantic failures and anchor quality bound evaluator validity

title: Phantom Guardrails: When Self-Improving Agent Harnesses Fix Failures That Never Happened
problem: Suppression-only harness optimization can retain guardrails justified by fabricated failures.
assumption_broken: A proposed fix can be unwarranted even when it does not reduce task scores or block legal behavior.
operational_signature: Plant → expose → propose → oracle-check → accept → audit
load_bearing_mechanism: A deterministic nonexistent-failure probe separates warranted edits from genre-prior-driven fabrication and tests warrant-aware acceptance.
limitations_evident: Single deterministic board-game micro-lab
Fabrication concentrates in one proposer
Abstract guard menu rather than free-form real harness editing

title: Self-Improving AI Coding Agents Through Accumulated Behavioral Rules: A Closed-Loop Framework
problem: Coding agents repeat reviewed mistakes across sessions because accepted corrections are not retained.
assumption_broken: Code review comments can become persistent class-level behavioral constraints rather than one-off fixes.
operational_signature: Generate → self-review → receive feedback → codify → validate → reload
load_bearing_mechanism: Accepted review learnings become version-controlled instruction rules mapped to pre-submission self-review checks.

improver_modified.how: Accumulated rules revise the self-review checklist and behavioral constraints used in later sessions.

limitations_evident: Observational deployment without an A/B control
One team and primary programming language
Only eleven sessions and a limited recurrence observation window

title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
problem: Behavioral harness modification requests do not map cleanly to distributed source implementation sites.
assumption_broken: Repository navigation can be organized by runtime behavior rather than files and functions alone.
operational_signature: Extract → organize → disclose → localize → verify → plan → resynchronize
load_bearing_mechanism: A source-grounded hierarchical behavior handbook and cross-stage state register guide progressive disclosure of affected edit sites.
limitations_evident: Evaluation measures plans rather than executed code changes
Only two harnesses and sixty requests
Reference plans and plan quality rely on LLM judges

title: HarnessBank: Semantic Gene-Bank Search with Gated Verification for Agent-Harness Self-Evolution
problem: Greedy harness search collapses diversity and promotes inactive or noisy benchmark-specific edits.
assumption_broken: Harness elites can be indexed by modification surface and failure pathology rather than one global incumbent or task identity.
operational_signature: Diagnose → reinvent → recombine → validate → activate → significance-test → archive
load_bearing_mechanism: Semantic gene-bank diversity combines with validity, activation and paired-significance gates before full candidate evaluation.
limitations_evident: SWE-bench held-out gain remains statistically preliminary
Pathology labels can be misdiagnosed
Cross-model gains depend on matching failure mechanisms

title: MemoHarness: Agent Harnesses That Learn from Experience
problem: One global harness is mismatched to diverse cases and scalar search scores fail to retain reusable diagnostic knowledge.
assumption_broken: A learned harness can be specialized once per test case from frozen training experience without test feedback or new search.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose → store → distill → retrieve → specialize
load_bearing_mechanism: A dual-layer bank of case diagnoses and global patterns conditions six-dimensional harness edits and feedback-free test-case adaptation.

improver_modified.how: The accumulating experience bank conditions the controller that proposes later harness configurations.

limitations_evident: Small eighteen-task cost evaluation split
Product baselines do not always hold the generator fixed
Caching assumptions drive monetary cost advantages

title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
problem: Agents discard successful workflows and repeatedly reconstruct procedures that could be directly reused.
assumption_broken: Inference-time workflows can compile into executable skills that reshape future workflows without weight training.
operational_signature: Retrieve → route → execute → verify → compile → admit → audit
load_bearing_mechanism: Verified workflow compilation enables direct skill replay or skill-conditioned generation, with contrastive utility suppressing negative transfer.

improver_modified.how: The expanding skill bank and negative-utility statistics change subsequent retrieval and workflow construction.

limitations_evident: Correctness-checkable domains are required
Each benchmark starts with an independent empty bank
Weak backbones can fail to populate admissible skills

title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
problem: Open-ended self-play trades task diversity against reliable verification and can collapse into invalid synthetic curricula.
assumption_broken: Skills can serve as evolving task-generation and verification interfaces rather than only solver-side procedures.
operational_signature: Route → generate → verify → rank → train → refine → induce
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolving skill packages constrain valid frontier-targeted task generation while open-ended exploration expands the curriculum.

improver_modified.how: GRPO updates the proposer and solver while the controller refines, induces and retires curriculum skills.

limitations_evident: Only tool calling and logical puzzles evaluated
Weak solvers need sufficient capability to bootstrap valid tasks
Five training iterations with no reported training-seed variance

title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
problem: Agents can keep self-authored verification scores high while degrading deployment policies.
assumption_broken: Self-written tests cannot alone authorize policy deployment when the agent controls both the policy and verifier.
operational_signature: Edit policy and tests → self-check → sealed audit → compare → accept or rollback
load_bearing_mechanism: A fixed hidden task-native audit returns only accept/reject and retains the entire incumbent policy-test state after clear regressions.

improver_modified.how: The agent rewrites its own tests, although a fixed sealed audit retains final deployment authority.

limitations_evident: Audit quality depends on deployment-relevant hidden instances
Ten-round heuristic-policy setting
Non-regression gate does not require genuine improvement

title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Automated data-centric researchers inconsistently turn checkpoint feedback into better training data and preserved model improvements.
assumption_broken: Research decisions can be evaluated separately from changes to the optimization, serving, and evaluation infrastructure.
operational_signature: Diagnose failures → synthesize supervision → train candidates → inspect feedback → select checkpoint
load_bearing_mechanism: A fixed shared post-training stack isolates iterative training-data strategy revision and checkpoint selection under common budgets.
limitations_evident: Selection and official evaluation reuse the same task subset
One representative run per setting
Researcher identity confounds model, scaffold, and reasoning effort

title: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution
problem: Independent-episode reinforcement learning fails to reward the extraction of skills that help later related tasks.
assumption_broken: Skill curation should be credited by downstream task outcomes rather than the outcome of the task that generated the experience.
operational_signature: Group related tasks → solve → curate shared document → reuse → credit downstream outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Decoupled cross-task credit assignment trains one policy to solve current tasks and rewrite a skill document for future tasks.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the shared policy responsible for skill curation as well as task solving.

limitations_evident: Requires task-family metadata
Models limited to at most 4B parameters
Only text environments with verifiable rewards

title: SERPO: Self-Evolving Rubric Policy Optimization for Open-Ended Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
problem: Answer-voting rewards cannot reliably distinguish quality among open-ended responses during label-free adaptation.
assumption_broken: Test-time reinforcement learning need not reduce responses to a shared canonical answer or use a fixed rubric.
operational_signature: Sample responses → archive contrasts → refine criteria → score probabilistically → update policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolving query-specific criteria discriminate ordered response archives and provide confidence-preserving rewards to the adapting actor.

improver_modified.how: The reward rubric evolves with actor responses while the rubric-generating and judging model weights remain fixed.

limitations_evident: In-domain adaptation reuses test prompts
Only two model configurations and limited long-horizon streams
Self-generated rubrics and judging inherit model biases and add computation

title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
problem: Skills summarized from isolated failures or teacher demonstrations may not change a weaker frozen student’s behavior.
assumption_broken: A useful skill must close the specific teacher-student behavioral gap rather than merely summarize a successful trajectory.
operational_signature: Contrast trajectories → propose patch → rerun recipient → refine → consolidate with history
load_bearing_mechanism: Behaviorally validated contrastive patches are consolidated through trace-linked edit histories to limit skill drift.
limitations_evident: Requires explicit success metrics
Depends on informative teacher-student contrasts
Textual guidance cannot supply capabilities beyond instruction following

title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: Self-graded incorrect memories receive inflated utility and compound errors through repeated trusted reuse.
assumption_broken: A stronger parametric re-grader is insufficient when its errors remain correlated with the original memory bias.
operational_signature: Retrieve episodes → generate answer → self-grade → audit behavior → demote utility → store
load_bearing_mechanism: Answer-free execution, degeneracy, and literal-grounding checks demote suspect memory utilities without rewriting content or consulting gold answers.
limitations_evident: End-to-end evaluation is confined to BIRD development data
Only two task-order seeds
Answer-free checks can miss executable but semantically wrong queries

title: HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses
problem: Unrestricted joint harness evolution overfits search tasks, misattributes failures, and produces interfering edits.
assumption_broken: Giving a meta-agent maximal editing freedom and only external trajectories is not the best route to transferable harness improvements.
operational_signature: Evaluate → ground feedback → constrain edits → optimize separate tracks → reconcile → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-agnostic edit constraints and trajectory-grounded feedback guide separate component tracks before their validated changes are reconciled.
limitations_evident: Evolution uses only 50 SWE-bench Verified tasks
Cross-model transfer evaluated on one additional model
Turn counts do not establish equal total token or rollout cost

title: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories
problem: Fixed harness editors generate plausible patches whose realized effects on target-agent success are unreliable.
assumption_broken: The harness engineer can be trained on the behavioral utility of executable edits rather than remaining a fixed prompted proposer.
operational_signature: Collect failures → propose executable hooks → validate → rerun full batch → reward editor → update
load_bearing_mechanism: Online GRPO trains a dedicated engineer from full-batch target performance changes after installing lifecycle-wide executable patches.

improver_modified.how: Cold-start supervised learning and online GRPO update the dedicated harness engineer while target-agent weights stay frozen.

limitations_evident: Main adaptation objective reruns the same task batch
No persistent patch memory across batches
Only one stronger-target adaptation rather than repeated co-evolution
